heading: MBTI - The foundation for backend character modeling, however unknown to many users.

blocks.html:
I created a low-fidelity prototype for the character creation process and conducted small-scale usability testing with 10 people. Creators got stuck in step 2 because they didn’t know what MBTI is.


However, due to the creation logic of the backend model, MBTI is a mandatory option that cannot be skipped! Our backend use MBTI personality types to create 16 sub-models that guide the general behavior of each chatbot category, and further tailored with different prompts.
